recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. Do not re-add Device.endpoint to core Device for the older R5 issue; the current core source reflects later final R6 decisions. Any future Endpoint.address comment work belongs with the already-audited FHIR-47048/FHIR Extension Pack follow-up, not this core seed.
issue_request: FHIR-32572 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Device issue for R5 asking to replace Device.url (0..1 uri) with Device.endpoint (0..* Reference(Endpoint)) so a single device can have multiple technical endpoints for different functions.
initial_application: Jira cites HL7/fhir PR #1489 commit 527030dccf2fe4612646ca5bff9208073feb0409. The implementation commit 09d68e1097e5dc81beadb0d43a68a576a584f119 added Device.endpoint as 0..* Reference(Endpoint), but Device.url remained until later FHIR-47048 work commented out the element and its search parameter.
additional_context: FHIR-47048 later identified FHIR-32572 as a prior approved but incomplete URL-to-endpoint change and decided URL can be represented in Endpoint.address while Device.endpoint moves to an extension. FHIR-32565 approved moving Device.endpoint and related Device elements to extensions, FHIR-48923 approved the Device communication extension work, and FHIR-47326 created the device-endpoint extension in the FHIR Extension Pack. FHIR-47048 and FHIR-48923 already have reconciliation commits on the combined branch, so they were not republished here.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Device is active in source/fhir.ini, but XML parsing of source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml and source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml found no active Device.url, no active Device.endpoint, and no active Device.url search parameter. The endpoint representation now exists as the FHIR Extension Pack device-endpoint extension.
